title: Presence
subtitle: Track who is home and drive the home mode, rules and scenes by occupancy.
empty: No residents yet. Add a household member and bind a geofencing source to track them.

aggregate.hint: Bind the Occupancy device's "Anyone home" to a presence_mode block to switch the home mode by occupancy.

dialog.userHelp: Optionally link this resident to a local user (Users page).
dialog.ownTracksIdHelp: The tracker id / username the OwnTracks app reports under (matched case-insensitively).
dialog.owntracksHint: Point the OwnTracks app (HTTP mode) at this URL:
dialog.trackingEnabled: Track this resident (count toward the occupancy aggregate)

settings.title: Geofence
settings.hint: Home/away is decided server-side: a reported position within the radius of the site location is home. Arrival is immediate; departure waits out the grace to absorb GPS jitter.
settings.radiusHelp: Distance from the site location counted as home.
settings.graceHelp: How long a resident must stay outside before flipping to away.
settings.tokenHelp: Optional shared secret the OwnTracks endpoint requires (?key= or X-Presence-Token). Set one when the endpoint is reachable off-LAN.
